name: MRO Electric and Supply
old_description: Quality Automation Supplies and Repair Services Provided to Over 15,000 Satisfied Customers
about:
MRO Electric and Supply operates from Cary, North Carolina, as an independent factory automation distributor. The company has been in business for more than a decade, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

The company supplies factory-new, surplus, and remanufactured industrial automation components from manufacturers such as Fanuc, Siemens, Schneider Electric, Modicon, Yaskawa, and Control Techniques. It also operates a repair shop that restores CNCs, PLCs, servo and spindle drives, motors, amplifiers, VFDs, and HMIs, typically completing repairs in three to five days. Stock items ship the same day for orders placed before 3 PM Eastern, and all products carry a minimum two-year warranty.

MRO serves industrial automation customers across sectors that depend on motion control and automation systems, including users of CNC machinery, PLC-based production lines, and servo-driven equipment. The company reports over 15,000 satisfied customers but does not disclose specific client names.

The company emphasizes rapid response, promising quotes within 10 minutes during business hours, and highlights its dedicated technician team as a differentiator for diagnosing and repairing servo drives with precision to minimize downtime.
